### The Costs and Demands of Love
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/costs-and-demands-love
Passage: Philemon 1:17-18
Points:
- Conversion to Jesus Christ radically transforms character and makes a person useful to the Kingdom.
- Biblical reconciliation between believers is a divine command that requires facing past wrongs directly.
- Paul appealed out of love rather than issuing an order, allowing Philemon's obedience to come freely.
- Gospel love compels believers to forgive costly debts and welcome former offenders as beloved brothers and sisters.
